text:
incident-bot: Pager — SEV2: potential cross-tenant KV-cache read detected affecting customer SierraCorp (VPC / dedicated pool). Auto-evidence capture started. Please @oncall-ian and @sre-lina. Details: anomalous GETs for prefix `sierra-prod/user:` served from pool `dedicated-us-west-2-42` while origin metadata indicates tenant id mismatch.

oncall-ian: Acknowledged. I'm on it. Bringing in runtime and security.

sre-lina: Seen the pager. Can you attach the capture? I'll start a quick grep across the kvcache logs for any other prefixes. Do we have a suspect deploy?

eng-runtime-marco: Not aware of a deploy in the last 12h. Quick check of routing table shows a transient mapping for `pool-42` -> `dedicated-us-west-2-42` plus a leftover `latebind` flag on nodes n-11,n-12. Could be a latebind race.

cust-eng-kai: Hi team — SierraCorp reports that several API responses contained identifiers that should be scoped to another tenant. They're paused but want confirmation ASAP. No PII confirmed yet.

oncall-ian: Ok, Lina/Marco — prioritize containment. Actions: 1) gather all keys read with prefix `sierra-prod/` in last 60m, 2) confirm whether any writes occurred, 3) if reads included other tenant prefixes, evict and block further reads from that pool.

sre-lina: Running grep across cache logs now. Example hits:```
2026-03-15T09:21:02Z kvcache:get pool=dedicated-us-west-2-42 key=halcyon-prod/session:abcd123 node=n-11 tenant_meta=tenant-901
2026-03-15T09:21:03Z kvcache:get pool=dedicated-us-west-2-42 key=sierra-prod/user:zyx987 node=n-11 tenant_meta=tenant-834
```
These two consecutive lines look suspicious — different tenant_meta on same node for proxied requests. Collecting full batch.

eng-runtime-marco: That pattern is consistent with a latebind path where the request's tenant header wasn't fully applied before prefix mask selection. Rolling a targeted mitig: temporarily set node affinity to deny-latebind on n-11,n-12, and force nodes to refresh routing table. Commands:```
# mark nodes read-only for latebind routing
redwoodctl nodes set-flag n-11 n-12 deny-latebind=true --reason "suspected cross-tenant reads"
# trigger routing refresh
redwoodctl routing reload --pool dedicated-us-west-2-42
```
Execute if SRE agrees.

sre-lina: Go ahead with flags. I'll snapshot logs and export keys list to secure bucket for evidence:```
aws s3 cp /tmp/sierra_evidence s3://redwood-evidence/2201122333/ --sse aws:kms
```

sec-oliver: Please hold on communications to the customer until we have initial impact assessment. We need to know whether any full records were exposed or only meta-level IDs. Also start an audit trail for who runs which commands.

pm-anya: I'll prep a short customer note template we can send once we confirm scope. Keep me in the loop.

support-jess: On standby for customer comms and opening a support ticket with SierraCorp. Ticket # will be added here when ready.

eng-runtime-marco: Flags applied to n-11,n-12 — they now report deny-latebind=true. Routing reload triggered; nodes rebalanced. Patch in place for immediate containment.

incident-bot: Auto-evidence: 142 matched GETs, 3 matched WRITE attempts. 2 unique keys from other-tenant prefix observed served to SierraCorp session flows. Evidence archived: s3://redwood-evidence/2201122333/manifest.json

sre-lina: Confirmed 142 GETs included 2 keys with prefix `halcyon-prod/` returned to sessions tied to SierraCorp. No successful writes observed other than read-retries. Pulling stack traces for the request paths.

sec-oliver: Good catch. Next steps: 1) Quarantine and rotate any short-lived tokens that might be impacted for SierraCorp, 2) run full config audit on pool binding rules, 3) preserve all logs for forensics. Also mark this incident for legal review.

cust-eng-kai: Thanks. SierraCorp wants: an explanation, whether customer data left the VPC boundary, and any remediation steps. They are sensitive to PII exposure.

oncall-ian: From current evidence: reads were returned from the kvcache within our infra to client sessions inside SierraCorp VPC — so data did not cross cloud egress; however, tenant mixing within the same dedicated pool can expose logical data between tenants. We'll phrase it carefully.

eng-runtime-marco: Root cause hypothesis: a race in the latebind/multi-tenant handler where header propagation to the prefix selector happened after the cache lookup. A fix requires ordering guarantee or atomic bind before prefix selection. I'll open an urgent PR with tests. For short-term: keep deny-latebind on affected nodes and add a transient policy to validate tenant header before any cache GETs.

sre-lina: Evidence export complete. Manifest:```
{
  "total_matches":142,
  "cross_tenant_hits":2,
  "nodes": ["n-11","n-12"],
  "evidence_s3":"s3://redwood-evidence/2201122333/"
}
```
Sec and legal can access the bucket.

sec-oliver: Access granted to sec and legal. Also please capture any correlated auth logs from the customer side if they can share — helps scope whether session token reuse occurred.

cust-eng-kai: I'll ask SierraCorp for auth logs and share via secure upload. They appreciate the quick containment. Please include ETA for full root cause and timeline.

pm-anya: ETA: containment done (flags + reload) within ~15 minutes of pager. Preliminary RCA and timeline draft within 3 hours, full patch + test + rollout within 48 hours. I'll prepare a customer-facing timeline.

support-jess: Created support ticket RED-45321 and linked evidence. Notifying SierraCorp that we're investigating; we'll follow up with a formal update once scope confirmed.

oncall-ian: Next: Marco, please push the validation policy as a hotfix to canary nodes in the pool and run a quick smoke test. Marco/Lina coordinate rollback plan. Sec to prepare customer comms draft. PM to own customer updates cadence.

eng-runtime-marco: Hotfix pushed to canary subset (n-21). Smoke tests:```
# smoke test script
curl -H "X-Tenant: sierra-prod" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/cache/get?key=sierra-prod/user:abc
# expect 200 and tenant header logged
```
Smoke passed on canary. Rolling to remaining nodes after 30m observation window.

sre-lina: Monitoring metrics: error spike during rollout window cleared after flags. No new cross-tenant hits observed since deny-latebind enabled.

sec-oliver: Prepare a brief for legal: number of affected keys, nature of data (IDs only vs full records), steps taken, retention location for evidence, would we be recommending any customer-side actions?

pm-anya: Drafting customer note now. Will include: what happened, what we saw, containment steps, what we're doing to fix, and recommended next steps for SierraCorp (rotate short-lived tokens, check auth logs).

cust-eng-kai: SierraCorp requests an Exec-level call if PII confirmed. Also asks for immediate rollback timeline for running workloads.

support-jess: Noted. I'll coordinate schedule and escalate the ticket for an executive bridge if needed.

oncall-ian: Handoff: I'm stepping off in 45m. Lina will remain primary until shift change. Marco/Marco on patching. Sec to continue investigation. Please update oncall channel when you see new cross-tenant hits.

sre-lina: I'll own the follow-up monitoring and evidence custody. Adding watch: `alerts:kvcache-cross-tenant` for stricter thresholds.

incident-bot: Status change: Mitigated -> containment in place. Auto-pager quiet.

sec-oliver: Keep evidence immutable. Legal looped in.

pm-anya: I'll send the initial customer update after brief sec review. Draft will be posted here for sign-off.

eng-runtime-marco: Opening PR: "ensure atomic tenant bind before cache selection" — will include unit + integration tests that simulate latebind. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/+/PR-8372

sre-lina: No further cross-tenant reads observed for 2h. Closing live mitigation ticket to monitoring. We'll keep the incident open for RCA and postmortem.

cust-eng-kai: Thanks everyone. SierraCorp appreciates the quick response. We'll share any logs as soon as available.

oncall-ian: Great work. Please keep this thread updated with timeline and follow-ups.

support-jess: Ticket RED-45321 updated with status: containment in place, evidence archived.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging at 2201122399.
